title: It is the best I have found but it’s not perfect
text: It is the best I have found but it’s not perfect. The cover is pretty soft and for the most part it serves its purpose however the way the seat/foot rest cover is built there’s nothing to attach it near where the seat meets the back of the chair so it regularly slips off of the seat when you stand up. I am going to try to attach some sort of loop on the back corners that go over the seat and tuck under the backrest of the chair to see if I can then somehow feed it through the chair and attach it to the feet on the bottom of the chair. That being said, it would be good if something like that was included in the product but as it is not, I’m going to leave it at three stars. I did like that there’s a little pocket on the left side that you can put your remote in or a book or something like that so that was helpful. I definitely recommend buying it as it is not bad for the price but it’s not fantastic.
